title: What does a typical occupational therapy session at Pinnacle Blooms Network involve?
metaTitle: Structure of a Typical Occupational Therapy Session | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Get an insight into what a typical occupational therapy session at Pinnacle Blooms Network involves and how our therapists align them with your child's needs.
html: The structure of an occupational therapy session at Pinnacle Blooms Network can broadly be divided into three parts. We start with warm-up activities to engage your child effectively. This is followed by specialized activities, games and exercises that are carefully curated to develop your child's skills. Finally, we conclude with a wind-down period to normalize the arousal levels. Furthermore, we value a parent's involvement in their child's developmental journey. Hence, regular updates and briefings about your child's progress form a major part of our therapy sessions.
